reading: core: WooCommerce's own Products menu with All Products and Add New, its Products settings tab with its General section, the product post type that installing WooCommerce adds, with its own capability type, and its own products APIs (REST v3 and v4, the products settings API and the Store API route; the coordinator's ruling makes WooCommerce's own API for its own feature core).
